dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Eh? We're not boarding? Well, guess we can just follow the riverbank instead!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: The terrain here is pretty tough! Aren't you scared of danger, Little Mao?

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Of course I am! But... I guess it's because you're afraid that you can bravely climb, right? If you weren't scared at all, you wouldn't care about what kind of roads or stones you tread on. Wouldn't that be more dangerous?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hah, Paimon scared of these mountain roads even without worrying about all that...

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Hahaha, are you afraid you'll fall off?

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Speaking of which, I've heard that the Jademouth was formed by a piece of jade left behind by an adeptus named Fujin...

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: In those days, the local god — a real baddie, of course — tried to redirect the Bishui River to flood both banks in Chenyu Vale, but an adeptus who was her subordinate, Fujin, disobeyed her orders and threw the jades she wore here.

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: The jades pinned the river down, and ever since, we've had no more floods, and everyone can live peaceful lives on both sides of the river.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? Fujin...? Paimon thinks we've met her...

dialogues.speaker: Little Mao
dialogues.text: Oh? So she was the adeptus you met?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: That's right. She even asked us to perform a bunch of errands for her. Said she wanted our help solving Qiaoying Village's problems. According to her, things could get ugly if those issues keep piling up!
